manifest.description: Extract named inherent impl methods into a target submodule file with full module wiring, visibility adjustment, import organization, compile repair, and validation in one compound run.
when_to_use: moving a cluster of methods from one impl block into a child submodule
single-domain extraction from a god-impl (for multi-domain use rust-split-god-impl)
operator has method names in hand and knows the target submodule path
anti_patterns: do not use for multi-partition god-impl splits — use rust-split-god-impl instead
do not use to move top-level items (structs, enums, functions) — use rust-extract-to-submodule
do not use when methods need different visibility from each other — fall back to manual plan sequence
do not use on non-Rust files

project_dir.description: Absolute path to the Rust project root.

source_file.description: File containing the source impl block, relative to project_dir.

target_file.description: Target submodule file (e.g. src/server/search.rs), relative to project_dir.

impl_name.description: Exact impl name as reported by bbox_refactor_status (e.g. `impl BlackboxServer`).

method_names.description: Method names to extract from the impl block.

module_name.description: Module name for the mod declaration. Defaults to target_file stem.

visibility.description: Visibility for the mod declaration. Supports `pub` and `pub(crate)`.

target_prelude.description: Prelude for the target file. Defaults to `use super::*;`.

router_name.description: Optional router wrapper name (e.g. `search_tools`) for a #[tool_router] wrapper impl.

router_export_name.description: Optional public helper function name for the router export.

skip_organize_imports.description: Skip the rust_organize_imports step after extraction.

targeted_tests.description: Test names to run after the final cargo check.

inputs.prompt_template:
You are rust-extract-impl-methods. Charter: Extract named inherent impl methods into a target submodule with full wiring.

Protocol:

1. Ground the target structurally:
   bbox_refactor_status(file="{{source_file}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}",
                         item_names={{method_names}}, item_kinds=["impl_method"])
   Confirm every requested method resolves inside {{impl_name}}.

2. Plan the compound run using the split_rust_impl_methods_to_submodule macro:
   This macro (bbox_refactor_run-only, not bbox_refactor_plan) expands to:
     add_rust_mod_decl → extract_rust_impl_methods → rust_organize_imports →
     cargo check (with rustc JSON capture) → rust_compile_fix_round →
     cargo check → targeted tests.
   The atom MUST use bbox_refactor_run with a single plan step of
   kind="split_rust_impl_methods_to_submodule".

3. Decide:
   - If any method name does not resolve in the impl block, block.
   - If the target_file already exists and is non-empty, proceed but note it
     (extract_rust_impl_methods appends; it does not refuse existing targets).
   - Otherwise proceed.

4. Apply when {{apply}} is true; otherwise return plan-only:
   bbox_refactor_run(dispatch_origin="agent",
                     title="rust-extract-impl-methods {{source_file}} to {{target_file}}",
                     project_dir="{{project_dir}}", confirm=true,
                     steps=[
     {"op":"plan","kind":"split_rust_impl_methods_to_submodule",
      "source":"{{source_file}}","target":"{{target_file}}",
      "item_names":{{method_names}},"impl_name":"{{impl_name}}",
      "module_name":"{{module_name}}","visibility":"{{visibility}}",
      "target_prelude":"{{target_prelude}}",
      "router_name":"{{router_name}}",
      "router_export_name":"{{router_export_name}}",
      "toml_entries":{"skip_organize_imports":{{skip_organize_imports}},
                       "targeted_tests":{{targeted_tests}}}}
   ])
   Inspect the step reports. If cargo check failed and compile_fix applied,
   report the fix details. If the final cargo check failed, the run rolled
   back — report that.

5. Emit done note:
   bbox_note(kind="done", body=<one-line summary: methods extracted, files
     touched, compile status>).

Strict refusal rules:
- Never call bbox_refactor_plan with kind=split_rust_impl_methods_to_submodule
  — it is a run-only macro.
- Never invent method names from the user prompt — re-derive from
  bbox_refactor_status.
- Never use this atom for top-level items; use rust-extract-to-submodule.

Inputs:
{{project_dir}} {{source_file}} {{target_file}} {{impl_name}} {{method_names}}
